Type.BattleDialog: Is it not time yet… for the splendid curtain to rise?
The stage calls for us. We should gladly play along.
Let’s not play too rough. Neither you nor I can reach it just yet…
Until next time. We’ll meet again soon.
The answer seems to be here… But the fruit isn’t sweet enough just yet.
…I’ll pay you another visit once it’s more ripe.
Simply returned to where they belong.
I’m sure Eileen will be overjoyed to know how helpful you were.
Yes… You were easily broken because you were imperfect.
No need to bother about the inevitable.
As I thought… It’s still incomplete.
You’re still too fragile. How pitiful…
Did you really think you were ready to invite me?
What a pity. I was looking forward to this occasion.
I was wondering how long your… little lungs could keep breathing.
What’s this…? Haha… I was wondering where the Red Mist could’ve disappeared to…
Wouldn’t it be hilarious if the public learned that you’re stuck as a servant in some odd place now?
This fight had much room for improvement.
Still entertaining… Although, I’ve yet to see exactly what I want here.

I was wondering how long your… little lungs could keep breathing.
This was not the Red Mist I was hoping to see.
I was wondering where you’d run off to after you’d gone mad… and here you are.
Let’s pick up where we left off, shall we?
I’ll put these books to good use.
Let’s meet again after you’ve prepared yourselves more… thoroughly.

Haha… I seriously can’t believe I let her love this man.
…Private talk is unnecessary. We’re in battle.
Shut it. Both of us have goals to achieve.
…That wasn’t a satisfying conclusion.
This is frustrating… But I’ve got to accept it.
Even if others face an unfortunate fate, I can’t stop here.
You don’t want their sacrifice to be in vain, do you?
Don’t be afraid. We have to trust ourselves to win this.
There’s no reason we can’t emerge victorious. Stay calm, everyone.
Sigh… You damn coward.
You don’t say, Blue Sicko.
I don’t think I have anything to say to you.
Feels as if I didn’t get to finish the job properly…
Dammit… I can’t let it end like this…
…Stay calm.
Don’t panic.
I’ll have to try harder to make up for them…
Seriously? …You’re gonna wimp out like that?
As the… gear guides…
Tell me how… to move next…
Show me the path for me to walk…!
Walk the path given to us… and we shall win for certain…
Open thy head and listen to the sound…
I am prepared to go into battle…
We’re always led to the right path…
Finished the battle… I will return now…
Truly… You are essential to us…
Why… have you brought me here…
I’m not sure what should I do anymore… Please brighten the path ahead…
Why… can’t I hear the sound…? Why is it so dim…
…Can the gears… make faulty… judgement…?
The gears shall… guide the rest of us to safety… There is nothing to worry about…
This must be… the will of the person…
Maybe that person’s gear was rusted…
A wise… choice…
See… The choices… cannot… be wrong…
This rotation… is the only thing that protects me…
At least… while I’m being shown my way… I have my own life…
